entries.title: Psalms 122:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> I rejoiced when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 122:2
segments: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 122:3
segments: Jerusalem, which art built as a city that is compact together,

entries.title: Psalms 122:4
segments: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Jah, a testimony to Israel, to give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 122:5
segments: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

entries.title: Psalms 122:6
segments: ¶Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

entries.title: Psalms 122:7
segments: Peace be within thy bulwarks, prosperity within thy palaces.

entries.title: Psalms 122:8
segments: For my brethren and companions' sakes I will say, Peace be within thee!

entries.title: Psalms 122:9
segments: Because of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
